> An advanced aerospace and embedded-systems project that combines orbital mechanics, autonomous hardware, RF data collection, environmental sensing, machine learning, and data analysis. The system predicts satellite passes using orbital data, autonomously points an antenna toward the satellite using an Arduino-controlled azimuth/elevation system, and collects environmental measurements through an ESP32. A Raspberry Pi serves as the central computing platform, coordinating the hardware, storing telemetry, processing satellite data, and running machine-learning models. The collected data is analyzed to determine how satellite position, elevation angle, atmospheric conditions, and other variables influence signal quality, while ML models are used to predict signal quality and identify anomalous satellite passes.
